tools.name: budget_status
tools.description: Budget status for every subscription: usage vs pace, verdicts, the planner's mode and the ranked executors. Call at session start and before large delegation decisions.

tools.name: delegate
tools.description: Hand an execution task to an executor (chosen by budget and priority unless `executor` is given). Returns a task_id immediately; poll with task_status or block with task_wait. Review the diff yourself before reporting done, then call task_review.

title.description: Short task title (trimmed, 1–60 characters), stored separately from the full goal. Omitted titles are derived from the first goal clause with paths, URLs and backticked code removed and word-boundary truncation with an ellipsis. Snapshot tasks, task events, task.get, task.list, attention titles and activity text expose this title; older tasks derive it on read.

tools.name: dispatch_preview
tools.description: Preview model/account selection with reasons and uncertainty. Uses cached observations; launches nothing and changes no strategy.

tools.name: guard_feedback
tools.description: Report that pacer's subagent guard decided wrongly (or rightly) for a given event.

tools.name: msg_close
tools.description: Close a task you started for further messages. Records no review verdict.

tools.name: msg_inbox
tools.description: Unread messages addressed to you.

tools.name: msg_log
tools.description: A task's message thread.

tools.name: msg_policy
tools.description: The effective messaging guardrail, or which rule decides a hypothetical send (check).

tools.name: msg_read
tools.description: Mark your messages read so msg_wait blocks until new ones arrive.

tools.name: msg_send
tools.description: Send a message to an agent. A message to a finished delegated task continues its native session in the same worktree; its reply arrives as a report in your inbox.

tools.name: msg_wait
tools.description: Block until a message or a reply arrives (timeout_s default 600, max 3000).

tools.name: report_limit
tools.description: Tell pacer an executor hit its plan limit (seen outside pacer). It is skipped until `until` (unix seconds) or its cooldown.

tools.name: route
tools.description: Which executors pacer would use for a task kind, in order, with reasons and exclusions. Runs nothing.

tools.name: strategy_list
tools.description: List strategies and their summaries. Always preview first and show the user the ranking change. Save only after the user agrees, with a reason. Never switch unless asked.

tools.name: strategy_preview
tools.description: Validate a draft without writing; compare ranking and routing against current usage. Always preview first and show the user the ranking change. Save only after the user agrees, with a reason. Never switch unless asked.

tools.name: strategy_save
tools.description: Save a validated draft. Replacing the active strategy changes live routing and requires overwrite:true and activeOk:true. Always preview first and show the user the ranking change. Save only after the user agrees, with a reason. Never switch unless asked.

who.description: Agent identity for the creation header

tools.name: strategy_show
tools.description: Show a strategy YAML and summary. Always preview first and show the user the ranking change. Save only after the user agrees, with a reason. Never switch unless asked.

tools.name: strategy_use
tools.description: Switch the active strategy only when explicitly asked. Always preview first and show the user the ranking change. Save only after the user agrees, with a reason. Never switch unless asked.

tools.name: task_answer
tools.description: Answer an executor question. A local task with a resumable session continues in that session once project policy admits it; otherwise the task is retried on the same executor. Only needs_input tasks can be answered.

tools.name: task_request_review
tools.description: Ask a human to decide about a completed result. Give the specific concern; this does not accept the work.

tools.name: task_review
tools.description: Record your verdict on a delegated task's result after reviewing it (ground truth for pacer's routing benchmark).

tools.name: task_send
tools.description: Send one message into a running interactive lane's live agent (delegate --interactive); a lane waiting on its question is answered with task_answer instead. Refused when the agent is not in its terminal's foreground, or while another client drove the lane in the last 60 seconds unless force.

tools.name: task_status
tools.description: Current state and result of a delegated task.

tools.name: task_stop
tools.description: Stop a delegated task and kill its executor.

tools.name: task_wait
tools.description: Block until a delegated task finishes or timeout_s passes (default 600, max 3000), then return its state.

tools.name: tree_status
tools.description: Turn state of every node in a task tree.

tools.name: work_answer
tools.description: Answer a managed work question and resume the same task.

tools.name: work_retry
tools.description: Retry settled managed work in the same task and worktree with revision protection.

tools.name: work_answer

tools.name: work_events

tools.name: work_retry
